NJR: New Jersey Resources delivers natural gas and invests in clean energy.
OGS: ONE Gas delivers natural gas in Oklahoma, Kansas and Texas.
SR: Spire delivers natural gas in Missouri and Alabama.
CPK: Chesapeake Utilities delivers gas and propane on the East Coast.
NWN: NW Natural delivers gas in Oregon and Washington.
BKH: Black Hills runs utilities across the Mountain West.
NWE: NorthWestern powers Montana and South Dakota.
AVA: Avista powers eastern Washington and Idaho.
TXNM: TXNM (PNM) powers New Mexico and Texas.
OTTR: Otter Tail runs a Minnesota utility plus plastics manufacturing.
AWR: American States Water runs California water utilities and military-base water systems.
CWT: California Water Service is a big California water utility.
MSEX: Middlesex Water runs New Jersey water utilities.
WTRG: Essential Utilities runs Aqua water systems and Peoples gas.
SJW: SJW runs water utilities in California and Connecticut.
GWRS: Global Water runs Arizona water utilities.
ARIS: Aris Water handles produced-water recycling for Permian drillers.
TAC: TransAlta generates power in Canada, pivoting from coal to renewables.
CWEN: Clearway owns wind, solar and gas plants selling contracted power.
BEPC: Brookfield Renewable's corporate class — global hydro, wind and solar.
NPWR: NET Power is developing zero-emission natural-gas power plants.
ORA: Ormat builds and runs geothermal power plants.
AMRC: Ameresco builds energy-efficiency and renewable projects.
AMPS: Altus Power owns commercial solar arrays.
NXT: Nextracker makes the trackers that tilt solar panels toward the sun.
SHLS: Shoals makes the wiring systems for solar farms.
GTLS: Chart makes equipment for handling LNG, hydrogen and industrial gases.
BLDP: Ballard makes hydrogen fuel cells for buses and trucks.
ADSK: Autodesk makes AutoCAD and other design/engineering software used across architecture, construction, manufacturing and media.
VEEV: Veeva Systems makes cloud software (CRM and data tools) used by pharmaceutical and biotech companies to run their sales and R&D operations.
DKS: DICK'S Sporting Goods is a large sporting-goods retailer, selling athletic apparel, footwear and equipment.
BBY: Best Buy is a consumer-electronics retailer selling computers, phones, TVs and appliances.
NTNX: Nutanix makes hybrid-cloud infrastructure software that lets companies run applications across their own data centers and the public cloud.
AIT: Applied Industrial Technologies distributes industrial parts like bearings, power transmission and fluid-power components to manufacturers.
HEI.A: HEICO makes replacement parts and electronic components for the aerospace and defense industry, largely serving the commercial-aviation aftermarket.
QXO: QXO is a building-products distributor (roofing, siding and related materials) built through acquisitions, including Beacon Roofing Supply.
